sections.description:
PUBLIC SECTOR COMPANIES (CORPORATE GOVERNANCE) RULES, 2013
PUBLIC SECTOR COMPANIES
(CORPORATE GOVERNANCE) RULES, 2013
(Amendment of Rule 1)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-II,
24th July, 2013]
S.R.O. 677(I)/2013, dated 24-7-2013.---In exercise of the
powers conferred by section 506 of the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of
1984) read with clause (b) of section 43 of the Securities and Exchange
Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997 (XLII of 1997), the Securities and Exchange
Commission of Pakistan, with the approval of the Federal Government, is pleased
to make the following further amendment in the Public Sector Companies
(Corporate Governance) Rules, 2013, namely:-
In the aforesaid
Rules, in rule 1, in sub-rule (2), for the
words and figures
"8th July 2013", the words and figures "8th August
2013" shall be substituted.
